description: This file defines the 'Person' class, extending 'Basic', representing a person entity with attributes such as name, email, phone details, and methods for handling localization, email relationship, and lawful basis settings within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Represents a person entity with attributes like name, contact info, email addresses, and related methods for CRM operations and localization.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Overrides parent retrieve to include proper name creation from localized fields.

methods.name: fill_in_relationship_fields
methods.description: Populates email relationship fields and handles legacy email retrieval.

methods.name: _create_proper_name_field
methods.description: Generates a full name and proper name field by combining salutation, title, first and last names considering localization and ACL permissions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Person object, handling emails, address fields, and workflow state.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the generated full name for summary display.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view, including email links and name fields.

methods.name: populateRelatedBean
methods.description: Populates related CRM beans with contact information, particularly for Company entities.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query for exporting person data, including email addresses and user info.

methods.name: setLawfulBasis
methods.description: Sets the lawful basis, source, and review date for the person, with validation.
